column3: MT 81:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; “on the Gittith” is rendered “On an instrument of Gath,” and NKJV adds “A Psalm.”
Close to the Hebrew; עִם־ נָבֶל (“with the lyre”) is rendered “with the lute.”
Close to the Hebrew; שׁוֹפָר (“the ram’s horn”) is rendered “the trumpet.”
Close to the Hebrew; “when he went out over the land” is rendered “When He went throughout the land.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the hiding place of thunder” is rendered “the secret place of thunder.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Israel did not yield to me” is rendered “Israel would have none of Me.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I gave it over” is rendered “I gave them over.”
Close to the Hebrew; יְכַחֲשׁוּ־ (“cringe”) is rendered “would pretend submission,” and “their time” “their fate.”
Close to the Hebrew; “he fed him” is rendered “He would have fed them.”
